claims.text: Trump posted on Truth Social on 19-20 February 2026 that he would direct Hegseth and relevant departments to begin identifying and releasing government files on alien and extraterrestrial life, UAP and UFOs.
Hegseth referred to the direction as 'that executive order' on 25 February 2026.
Sean Parnell said the department 'looks forward to working with the interagency to fulfill the president's directive.'

claims.source: Inference from the absence of any cited EO number across the portal, AARO's materials and DefenseScoop's coverage
claims.text: No executive order text establishing PURSUE has appeared on war.gov, aaro.mil or in the contemporaneous reporting; the programme appears to rest on informal direction, leaving its scope and continuation entirely discretionary.

Trump directed Hegseth and other departments to 'begin the process of identifying and releasing Government files related to alien and extraterrestrial life, unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP), and unidentified flying objects (UFOs), and any and all other information connected to these highly complex, but extremely interesting and important, matters.'
Sean Parnell: 'The department looks forward to working with the interagency to fulfill the president's directive.'

Tim Gallaudet: 'As with other promises made by Trump, I'll believe it when I see it,' referencing unreleased Epstein files. Avi Loeb: 'One step that can be taken immediately is to declassify events from 50 years ago.'
ODNI ES 2026-00818 grounds the NDA-waiver implementation on 'Presidential Direction' rather than on any cited executive order number.

No signed executive order on UAP declassification exists in the public record as of 12 August 2026, despite Hegseth referring on 23 February 2026 to 'that executive order'. Reasoning: contemporaneous reporting describes a Truth Social post; the ODNI implementing memorandum cites 'Presidential Direction' without an order number.

claims.source: Truth Social post, 20 February 2026, reported by Al Jazeera and others
claims.text: Trump announced he would direct the Secretary of War and other departments and agencies to begin identifying and releasing files on alien and extraterrestrial life, UAP and UFOs.
Rep. Anna Paulina Luna publicly thanked the President as chair of the task force that investigates the subject; Sen. John Fetterman called the decision fantastic.

desc: The originating instrument of PURSUE, and a thin one. On 19-20 February 2026 Trump posted on Truth Social that he would direct Secretary of War Hegseth and other relevant departments and agencies to begin the process of identifying and releasing government files related to alien and extraterrestrial life, UAP and UFOs, 'and any and all other information connected to these highly complex, but extremely interesting and important, matters.' Hegseth referred to it five days later as 'that executive order,' but the contemporaneous reporting describes a social-media post and no signed order has surfaced in the public record as of 12 August 2026. Chief Pentagon Spokesman Sean Parnell said the department 'looks forward to working with the interagency to fulfill the president's directive.' The consequence of the missing instrument is that PURSUE has no published scope, no defined universe of covered records, no declassification standard, no review authority named in writing, no compliance deadline and no reporting requirement - every one of which the Burlison FY2027 NDAA amendment would supply by statute. It is a release programme that exists at will.
